prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: animation sprite sheet for a fictional grade-three JRPG educational game.
Input images: Image 1 is the vehicle sheet EDIT TARGET; Image 2 is the selected character IDENTITY REFERENCE only.
Primary request: Edit image 1 by replacing ONLY the original driver in every cell with the boy explorer from image 2: dark brown hair, large warm brown eyes, beige safari hat with a leaf, teal blue explorer vest over cream sleeves, teal neckerchief, brown backpack. Preserve the mint green compact open-top car, cream bumpers, round headlights, brown seating and all sixteen vehicle views. Each replacement is actually seated within the driver's seat, with hands/paws resting on the steering wheel, lower torso and legs occluded by vehicle body; the driver occupies the same cabin position as the original. One driver per car, no floating character, no separate standing character.
Composition: Preserve the square 4-by-4 aligned grid and all 16 cells. EXACT row-major directions: row 1 E frame A, E frame B, SE frame A, SE frame B; row 2 S A, S B, SW A, SW B; row 3 W A, W B, NW A, NW B; row 4 N A, N B, NE A, NE B. East points right; south shows the front; north shows the back. Each pair differs only by subtle motion/bobbing. Vehicles centered within their equal-size cells with consistent wheel baseline and safe magenta margin; no overlap and no cropping.
Style: Preserve original soft painted chibi JRPG style, bold clean silhouette, original vehicle colors, proportions and viewpoint.
Background: ENTIRE background must be fully opaque, flat, uniform exact chroma #FF00FF. No transparency, no floor, no cast shadows, no gradients, no magenta cast or reflections on subjects. No text, labels, grid lines, watermark or extra objects.
vehicleDescription: mint green compact open-top car, cream bumpers, round headlights, brown seating
